Portfolio Review + Spark Sessions: Spooky Miniature Challenge Youth (Ages 13 – 17) | Free, Drop-In Program October 24 (PA DAY) | 2:00 – 3:00 pm Underground Gallery (Level B1) | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Looking to pursue arts post-secondary? Bring in your portfolio for a free review and feedback from the Gallery Team at the Aurora Cultural Centre; all art-related inquiries are welcome! Occurring simultaneously, tap into your creativity by dropping in a Spark Session! Spark Sessions are free, recurring, student-led arts and craft workshops for youth from ages 13 to 17. Each Spark Session is themed, with materials and snacks provided at no cost (while quantities last). This session’s theme: Spooky Miniature Challenge About Youth Artists on the Rise! (YAR): Spark Sessions run as part of Youth Artists on the Rise! (YAR), a community for arts-impassioned youth ages 13-17 to develop their skills in the arts, make connections, and build a community for collaboration and growth. Participants have access to art studio space, exhibiting opportunities, and workshops. Register for YAR now!
